findings.title: Single-column CSV/TXT files load silently corrupted (delimiter sniffing splits words into columns)
findings.repro:
import pandas as pd, hypertools as hyp
pd.DataFrame({'solo': [1, 2, 3]}).to_csv('single_col.csv', index=False)
print(hyp.load('single_col.csv'))  # WRONG: 3 columns
print(pd.read_csv('single_col.csv'))  # correct: 1 column 'solo'
findings.expected: DataFrame with shape (3, 1), single column 'solo' containing [1, 2, 3]
findings.actual:
s   l  Unnamed: 2
0  1 NaN         NaN
1  2 NaN         NaN
2  3 NaN         NaN
shape: (3, 3) columns: ['s', 'l', 'Unnamed: 2']   (sniffer chose the letter 'o' in the header 'solo' as delimiter)

findings.title: load('sotus') returns a sklearn Pipeline, not the documented State of the Union speeches (duplicate Google Drive id with nips_model)
findings.repro:
import hypertools as hyp
d = hyp.load('sotus')
print(type(d))  # sklearn.pipeline.Pipeline, not text data
import hashlib, pathlib
h = lambda p: hashlib.md5(pathlib.Path(p).expanduser().read_bytes()).hexdigest()
print(h('~/hypertools_data/sotus'), h('~/hypertools_data/nips_model'))
findings.expected: A collection of State of the Union speech texts (1989-2018), per the load() docstring

findings.title: Unauthenticated 538 CSV download bypasses the transient-5xx retry helper
findings.repro:
# code inspection: hypertools/io/sources.py:370
#   raw, _ = _fetch_bytes(f'{_538_RAW}/{slug}/{csv_name}')  # no retry
# vs listing (line 281) and authenticated fetch (line 367) which use _github_get_with_retry.
# Retry helper itself verified for real:
from hypertools.io.sources import _github_get_with_retry
# (real ThreadingHTTPServer returning 502 twice then 200 -- see phase2_network.py)
# -> ('recovered', 3)
findings.expected: All three 538 HTTP calls (listing, authenticated CSV fetch, anonymous raw CSV fetch) retry transient 502/503/504
findings.actual: Anonymous CSV fetch is a single-shot requests.get inside _fetch_bytes; a transient 502 there raises through pd.read_csv wrapping into the load failure

findings.title: repr() of every hosted *_model pipeline crashes under the shipped sklearn (notebook display raises AttributeError)
findings.repro:
import hypertools as hyp
m = hyp.load('wiki_model')
print(m)  # AttributeError
findings.expected: Pipeline repr prints (as any sklearn estimator); no crash on display
findings.actual:
AttributeError: 'Pipeline' object has no attribute 'transform_input'
(raised from sklearn/utils/_pprint.py -> pipeline.get_params during repr; transform() itself works: output shape (1, 50))

findings.title: Local-file parse failures escape as cryptic internal errors (empty CSV, unknown binary, gzipped CSV)
findings.expected: HypertoolsIOError naming the file and the formats attempted, with a hint (e.g. 'file is empty', 'looks gzip-compressed -- decompress first')
findings.actual:
empty.csv -> Error Could not determine delimiter
t.csv.gz -> UnpicklingError invalid load key, '\x1f'.
binary.garbage -> UnpicklingError invalid load key, '\x00'.

findings.title: A mistyped bare filename triggers a real DNS lookup (any 'word.word' string is treated as a URL)
findings.expected: Fast failure: 'local file not found' digest without a network attempt for an obvious filename
findings.actual:
HypertoolsIOError: could not load 'f19_missing_xyz.csv'. Tried, in order:
  - ...
  - local file: not found at f19_missing_xyz.csv
  - URL (https://f19_missing_xyz.csv): ConnectionError: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='f19_missing_xyz.csv', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: / (Caused by NameResolutionError(...Failed to resolve 'f19_missing_xyz.csv'...))

findings.title: load() docstring dataset descriptions wrong: 'spiral is numpy array' (it is a list of 2 arrays); 'mushroomm' typo
findings.repro:

s = hyp.load('spiral')
print(type(s), len(s), np.asarray(s).shape)

findings.title: Stale step numbering and stale module references in sources.py/load.py comments
findings.repro: grep -n 'steps 4-9\|# 4. local file\|# 9. any URL\|tools.load\|tools.sources' hypertools/io/sources.py hypertools/io/load.py
findings.expected: Comments numbered 6-11 to match the documented chain; module refs io.load/io.sources
findings.actual: sources.py:498 'steps 4-9 of the chain'; sources.py:517 '# 4. local file' ... sources.py:580 '# 9. any URL'; sources.py:6 'tools.load'; load.py:265 'tools.sources'

findings.title: Docstring claims the 538/kaggle prefixes 'never collide with another resolver', but they shadow existing local files
findings.repro:
import os, pandas as pd, hypertools as hyp
os.makedirs('fivethirtyeight', exist_ok=True)
pd.DataFrame({'local': [1]}).to_csv('fivethirtyeight/bechdel', index=False)
print(hyp.load('fivethirtyeight/bechdel').columns[:3].tolist())
findings.expected: Either the local file wins, or the docstring notes that the prefixes shadow same-named relative paths and that './' forces local resolution

findings.title: Non-string dataset arguments raise raw internal TypeErrors (expandvars / dict-hash) instead of a friendly message
findings.expected: TypeError like: hypertools.load() expects a dataset name/path string or a list of strings; got int
findings.actual:
int -> expected str, bytes or os.PathLike object, not int
NoneType -> expected str, bytes or os.PathLike object, not NoneType
float -> expected str, bytes or os.PathLike object, not float
dict -> unhashable type: 'dict'

findings.title: A stale/invalid GITHUB_TOKEN env var breaks 538 loads with a 401 that never mentions the token
findings.repro: GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_invalid_token_for_audit python -c "import hypertools as hyp; hyp.load('fivethirtyeight/bechdel')"
findings.expected: Error mentions the environment token as the likely cause and the fix (unset/refresh)
findings.actual: HypertoolsIOError: GitHub API request for fivethirtyeight/data/bechdel failed with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

findings.title: hyp.save() ignores the file extension -- save(df, 'data.csv') writes pickle bytes into a .csv
findings.repro:
import pandas as pd, hypertools as hyp
df = pd.DataFrame({'a': [1, 2]})
hyp.save(df, 'lie.csv')
print(open('lie.csv', 'rb').read(2))  # b'\x80\x04'
pd.read_csv('lie.csv')  # UnicodeDecodeError
findings.expected: save(df, '*.csv') writes real CSV (or at minimum warns that a pickle is being written with a non-pickle extension)
findings.actual:
b'\x80\x04'
UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x80 in position 0: invalid start byte  (from pd.read_csv; hyp.load('lie.csv') round-trips only via pickle sniffing)

findings.title: 'Tried, in order' digest rough edges: URL inputs listed as local-file attempts with collapsed slashes; directories reported 'not found'; host:port schemeless URLs get no URL attempt
findings.expected: Digest skips (or rephrases) the local-file line for URL-shaped input; says 'is a directory' when it is; suggests adding http:// for host:port strings
findings.actual: "- local file: not found at https:/raw.githubusercontent.com/..." ; "- local file: not found at /tmp/...data" (an existing directory); '127.0.0.1:61871/t.csv' digest ends at the local-file line with no URL attempt
